_about: The play journal's kinds (docs/design/play-journal.md): each kind is one file, journal/<id>.jsonl, beside the logs folder. src/engine/play_journal.rs records them; scripts/mcp-server.js (dev_play_journal) and the Dev page read these words. A new kind is a row here and a record() call at the place that knows the event. Never in any kind: the words of a message, a key, a token, a recovery phrase, a file's contents.

kinds.about: Every warning and error line the game logged (its level and module), the same words run.log holds.
A panic's message and the version, written at once.
Mark this moment (F8): its number, its picture (marks/<n>.png), the page and where the player stood.
A hitch: a frame of at least 100 ms and three times the recent average, at most one every 2 s.
Signed in, the connection lost, a chat line refused (why), a message, call or trade refused by the other person's choices (which kind): the server and the kind, never the words or who.
World entered or left, aboard or not, the room changed, a fall (a landing at 8 m/s or more), death, a save written.
